info.name: NEXUS - AI Assistant Service
info.description: General-purpose AI financial assistant. Provides streaming chat (SSE) and multimodal document analysis (bill/receipt image + question). Port: 8090

request.description:
Main streaming AI chat endpoint. Returns Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) as the AI generates the response token by token.

Request body (Map<String, String>):
- message (String, required): The user's message
- sessionId (String, optional): Conversation session ID for context continuity; auto-generated UUID if not provided

Response: Flux<String> — SSE stream of text tokens

formdata.description: Image file of bill, receipt, or document (JPEG, PNG, PDF)

formdata.value: How much did I spend on food this month? Can you break it down by category?

formdata.description: Optional session ID for conversation continuity

request.description:
Multimodal document analysis: upload a financial document image and ask a question. The vision model extracts data and the primary model answers.

Request (multipart/form-data):
- file (file, required): Image file (JPEG, PNG) of bill, receipt, bank statement, etc.
- message (text, required): Question about the document
- sessionId (text, optional): Conversation session ID

Response: Flux<String> — SSE stream of text tokens (text/event-stream)

formdata.value: What is the total amount and due date on this invoice?

request.description:
Dedicated document analysis endpoint (same capability as /api/v1/ai/chat/analyze-document). Uses multipart/form-data.

Request (multipart/form-data):
- file (file, required): Image file
- message (text, required): Question about the document  
- sessionId (text, optional): Session ID

Response: Flux<String> — SSE text/event-stream
